# Hierarchical PLS_DA Evaluation
# Evaluation on F1-Score and MCC on Overall
```{r}
## Import all results
initial_data <- list(
    "all_binary_1000" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "all_binary_1250" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/plsda_1250_all.csv"),
    "all_weighted_1000" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "all_weighted_1250" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/weighted_plsda_1250_all.csv"),
    "austrian_binary_1000" = read.csv("results/austrian/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "austrian_binary_1250" = read.csv("results/austrian/plsda_1250_all.csv"),
    "austrian_weighted_1000" = read.csv("results/austrian/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "austrian_weighted_1250" = read.csv("results/austrian/weighted_plsda_1250_all.csv")
)

# remove all column except 1 - 5 and 15
data <- lapply(initial_data, function(df) df[, c(1:6, 10:13, 17,18)])

# add details about the sample_weight
data <- Map(function(df, nm) {
  df$Sample_weight <- if (grepl("weighted", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "TRUE"
  } else {
    "FALSE"
  }
  df
}, data, names(data))

## add details about the dataset
data <- Map(function(df, nm) {
  df$Dataset <- if (grepl("austrian", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "Austrian"
  } else {
    "All"
  }
  df
}, data, names(data))

# combine all dataframes into one
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, data)

# except F1_Score and MCC, transform all to factor
combined_data[c(1:6, 13,14)] <- lapply(combined_data[c(1:6, 13,14)], as.factor)
str(combined_data)

#transform MCC using Fisher's z transformation and add TPR and TNR
combined_data$MCC_z <- atanh(combined_data$MCC)
combined_data$TPR <- combined_data$TP / (combined_data$TP + combined_data$FN)
combined_data$TNR <- combined_data$TN / (combined_data$TN + combined_data$FP)

#rename the columns
library(dplyr)
lme_data <- combined_data %>%
 rename(
   Grinding = Sample_source,
   Toxin = Target_toxin,
   Weighting = Sample_weight
 )
```

## Analysis using Linear mixed-effects
This experiment is performed using Full Factorial Design with 5 factors: Sample_weight, Target_toxin, Preprocessing, Variable_Selection and Sample_weight.

```{r}
#### Data analysis for MCC_z
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
#Fit the linear mixed-effects model until three-way interaction
str(lme_data)
model_mcc <- lmer(MCC_z ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Downsampled + Dataset + Weighting)^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_data)
anova(model_mcc)
summary(model_mcc)

# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_mcc)
r2(model_mcc)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_mcc <- emmeans(model_mcc, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Downsampled * Dataset * Weighting, pbkrtest.limit = 12800)
mcc_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_mcc$emmeans)
mcc_pipelines_df <- mcc_pipelines_df[order(-mcc_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for F1_Score
model_f1 <- lmer(F1_score ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Downsampled + Dataset + Weighting)^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_data)
anova(model_f1)
summary(model_f1)
# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_f1)
r2(model_f1)

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_f1 <- emmeans(model_f1, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Downsampled * Dataset * Weighting, pbkrtest.limit = 12800)
f1_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_f1$emmeans)
f1_pipelines_df <- f1_pipelines_df[order(-f1_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for TPR
model_tpr <- lmer(TPR ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Downsampled + Dataset + Weighting)^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_data)
anova(model_tpr)
summary(model_tpr)
# determine the ICC (intraclass correlation) of the model
library(performance)
icc(model_tpr)
r2(model_tpr) 

#select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_tpr <- emmeans(model_tpr, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Downsampled * Dataset * Weighting, pbkrtest.limit = 12800)
tpr_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_tpr$emmeans)
tpr_pipelines_df <- tpr_pipelines_df[order(-tpr_pipelines_df$emmean), ]


# Data analysis for TNR
model_tnr <- lmer(TNR ~ (Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Downsampled + Dataset + Weighting)^3 + (1|Split), data = lme_data)
anova(model_tnr)
summary(model_tnr)

# select the best pipelines
best_pipelines_tnr <- emmeans(model_tnr, pairwise ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * Variable_Selection * Downsampled * Dataset * Weighting, pbkrtest.limit = 12800)
tnr_pipelines_df <- as.data.frame(best_pipelines_tnr$emmeans)
tnr_pipelines_df <- tnr_pipelines_df[order(-tnr_pipelines_df$emmean), ]
```


```{r}
# Load your libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr) # For the comparison stars

# 1. Main Effect Plot
# Load your libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Create the beautiful Violin + Boxplot combo
ggplot(lme_data, aes(x = Weighting, y = MCC, fill = Weighting)) +
  # The violin layer (trim = FALSE keeps the beautiful natural tails)
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE, color = NA) +
  # The tiny inner boxplot (width = 0.1 keeps it slim)
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Your custom colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#fca311", "TRUE" = "#14213d")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of MCC by Weighting",
    subtitle = "Violin shapes show the full density of your 12,800 data points",
    x = "Was Weighting Applied?",
    y = "MCC Score"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "none" # Hide the legend for a cleaner look
  ) +
  # Adding those helpful significance stars back in!
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
    label = "p.signif", 
    method = "t.test"
  )

# 2. Interaction Plot (Swapping X and Fill for cleaner brackets)
ggplot(lme_data, aes(x = Toxin, y = MCC, fill = Weighting)) +
  # Dodged violins to sit them next to each other
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE, color = NA) +
  # Dodged inner boxplots
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.1, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#fca311", "TRUE" = "#14213d")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density of MCC Scores by Toxin and Weighting",
    x = "Toxin Type",
    y = "MCC Score",
    fill = "Weighting Applied?"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  # Adding the stars for the groups
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = Weighting), 
    label = "p.signif", 
    method = "t.test"
  )

str(mcc_pipelines_df)

library(ggplot2)

library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Calculate the marginal mean for JUST Weighting
emm_weighting <- emmeans(model_f1, ~ Weighting, pbkrtest.limit = 12800)
emm_weighting_df <- as.data.frame(emm_weighting)
str(emm_weighting_df)
# 2. Plot the isolated effect
ggplot(emm_weighting_df, aes(x = Weighting, y = emmean, color = Weighting)) +
  # Draw the error bar
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.1, size = 1) +
  # Draw the point estimate
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#fca311", "TRUE" = "#14213d")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Main Effect of Weighting",
    subtitle = "Model-adjusted marginal means (with 95% CIs)",
    x = "Was Weighting Applied?",
    y = "Estimated MCC"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
